title: Pure Tistina
summary: Tistina cards only, with generic staples. The Tistina gods flip the opponent's monsters face-down and send every face-up card they control to the GY, on your turn with Crystal God Tistina and on theirs with Demigod of the Tistina. Fallen of the Tistina places Divine Domain Baatistina from the Deck, which mills a Tistina and calls Crystal God Tistina once the opponent has three face-up cards. Miasma Dragon Tistina, the newest card, searches any other Tistina monster when summoned and comes back from the GY while a Field Spell is out. Three Level 10s make Tistina, the Divinity that Defies Darkness.
main: Miasma Dragon Tistina
Newest card: searches a Tistina monster when summoned; revives itself while a card is in the Field Zone.
Fallen of the Tistina
Starter: sends itself to place Divine Domain Baatistina from the Deck.
Demigod of the Tistina
Summons itself next to a Tistina card and searches a Tistina Spell/Trap; wipes on their turn.
Crystal God Tistina
Flips their monsters face-down and sends their face-up cards to the GY.
Sentinel of the Tistina
Summons itself; destroys your own Tistina or face-down card to search.
Hound of the Tistina
Summons itself from the hand or GY; Tistinas attack directly past face-down monsters.
Returned of the Tistina
Summons itself at another Tistina's Level; attaches itself to an Aqua Xyz.
Tainted of the Tistina
Tributes one of their face-down monsters to Tribute Summon itself.
Divine Domain Baatistina
Field Spell: mills a Tistina and summons Crystal God Tistina from the Deck.
Breath of the Tistina
Extra Tistina Normal Summon; flips a monster face-down to search.
Play of the Tistina
Quick-Play: summons a Tistina from the hand or GY until the End Phase.
Embrace of the Tistina
Flips an activating monster face-down and steals a face-down monster.
Discordance of the Tistina
Banishes their GY face-down; recovers a Tistina.
Signs of the Tistina
Trap monster: a Level 10 body that takes a monster with it on their turn.
extra: Tistina, the Divinity that Defies Darkness
Rank 10: sends their face-down cards to the GY when summoned.
